description: Last day of a deadline in Spain counted from a notification: administrative (Ley 39/2015: business days exclude Saturdays, Sundays and holidays; months from date to date; extended to the next business day; a holiday in either the person's or the authority's region counts, art. 30.6) or court (LEC/LOPJ: also August and 24 December – 6 January non-business since LO 1/2025, unless urgent; plus the 15:00 next-day filing margin of LEC art. 135). Uses the official BOE holidays of the region, including the ones moved to Monday. Returns the last day, the days skipped by name, the extension if it fell on a non-business day, and the rules applied with their articles. Measured: Sonnet and Haiku miss the 2025 court-holiday reform even when given the holidays. Deterministic; it is a calculation, not legal advice.

localHolidays.description: Municipal holidays of the place (there is no single official source)

notified.description: Date of notification (counting starts the next day)

region.description: Autonomous community of the authority/court: ES-MD, ES-CT, ES-AN…

secondRegion.description: Administrative: the person's region if different (its holidays also count, art. 30.6)

urgent.description: Judicial: urgent proceedings, where August and Christmas do count
